experiment: E115 (scores it); pool and predictions: Q133(b)

fp16.a_mant_b_randn.group: fp16: A busy in its 10 mantissa bits only, B random

fp16.g_blanes_alt.group: fp16: B gate, every lane on and off each cycle

fp16.s_inword0.group: fp16: every two-term update is a1*b1 - a1*b1 = 0

fp16.s_wpair0.group: fp16: the two-term sums cancel in pairs of k-groups

fp16.x_logu_s50.group: fp16: exponents over the whole normal range, half the words zero

fp32.a_colconst_b_randn.group: A random in value but constant down each column

fp32.a_lo8_b_pi.group: the same A, B constant pi (a quiet partner)

fp32.a_lo8_b_randn.group: A busy in its low 8 mantissa bits only, B random

fp32.g_arows_alt.group: A gate, 50% of micro-ops, alternating every two cycles

fp32.g_blanes_alt.group: B gate, 50% of lane-cycles, every lane on and off each cycle

fp32.g_blanes_steady.group: B gate, 50% of lane-cycles, steady (lanes 0-3 never live)

fp32.m_blines_eq.group: all 16 B lines identical: lanes alternate, lines never change

fp32.m_bpair_eq.group: B column l+8 = column l: lanes never alternate, lines still random

fp32.s_bridge.group: signs alternate: the sum climbs 8 k and walks back down

fp32.s_drift12.group: signs alternate with a 2^-12 residual: the sum drifts slowly

fp32.s_pair0.group: signs alternate: the sum returns to exactly 0 every two k

fp32.x_logu_s50.group: exponents spread over 2^-30..2^30, half the words zero

fp32.z_single.group: all +0.0 but one A and one B word, which meet once an op

int8.a_colconst_b_full.group: int8: A random in value, constant down each word-column

int8.a_low2_b_full.group: int8: A busy in its two low bits only, B random

int8.g_awords_alt.group: int8: A gate on every other micro-op

int8.g_bpairs_steady.group: int8: B column pairs gated steadily, 50%

int8.st_f32bytes.group: int8 run on the raw bytes of a fresh fp32 randn tile

int8.z_diag.group: int8: one live A word per word-column (15 of 16 micro-ops gated)

units: D, W over the type's own zeros at 600 MHz (E78's reduction), footings a3 / c1 / new as this script's docstring says
